title: Acoustic limit of Boltzmann equations for gas mixture
summary: In this paper, we study the hydrodynamic and acoustic limit from Boltzmann equations for two species gas mixture with potential $γ\in \left(-3, 1\right]$. % in the whole space $(x \in \mathbb{R}^3)$.Here the particle masses are different which derives to the loss of symmetry to the linearized collision operator. %This paper resolves it precisely by using a framework based on vector-valued functions.
